stage6a_instruction: After Stage 6A, put the two strongest Stage 6A ids in stage6b_candidates and set stage6a_ready=true.
stage6b_instruction: After the 6B seed-1 screen, set the winning Stage 6A id and policy, then set stage6b_ready=true before 6B confirmation or 6C.
stage6c_instruction: After the 6C seed-1 screen, choose direct_k400, random_supcon, k400_supcon, or k400_supcon_patch_frozen and set stage6c_ready=true before multi-seed confirmation.
